reviews.text:
I took my cat, Fynn, to Scout for a UTI, and the experience couldn't have been better. Dealing with a sick pet is always stressful, but their team stepped in right away and provided immediate care. Every staff member I interacted with was incredibly kind, attentive, and helpful.

What really stood out was that they took the time to follow up afterward to see how Fynn was recovering. It’s clear they genuinely care about their patients. I highly recommend Scout to anyone looking for a reliable, compassionate vet!

The Scout team was so helpful in an urgent care visit for my senior cat. They were great at explaining my options and letting me know all medical possibilities without being alarmist. You can tell they love animals too, which made me feel much better having my cat in their care.

Ease of making a same day appointment!!
Efficient, knowledgeable, and caring staff made the urgent issue with my dog bearable!
It’s great to know a facility like this exists, and I will be recommending Scout to friends/family!

I have brought both my cats to Scout on Lincoln ave at least once. Each time they have been wonderful. Patient and caring. They are also the most cost effective of urgent cares that I have been able to find. They make sure to offer different treatment options keeping cost in mind. I’m so grateful for the staff and the team there who were so caring to my Lady and Rocco!

Very impressed with the front desk and the doctor. Was my first time there. The doctor was very thorough on the diagnosis and the plan on getting my cat well. Spent as much time with me explaining everything. Very impressed

Sandusty had a toothache on a weekend. She was very uncomfortable and kept telling me to do something. Uptown Animal Hospital recommended Scout to me. It was easy to make an appointment. I did it online and was delighted it had openings. Our appointment was on a Saturday at 5:00. It was easy traveling on CTA to Lincoln, Halsted, Fullerton. The place was immaculate, friendly. On Monday morning, I received a phone call from my vet saying that I went to Scout. If only people doctors behaved so responsibly. I'd recommend Scout to anybody.

Hey Kristin! 

Thank you so much for the five-star rating, we really appreciate you taking a moment to do that. Ratings like yours help other pet parents find us when they need urgent care, and we're glad to have earned it.

Take Care,
The Scout team
Great experience for our itchy dog

We were very satisfied with our experience at Scout this week. We came in to get treatment for our dog's serious itching and they were able to see us the same day. We received a friendly greeting from the receptionist, and the vet tech and veterinarian team were also very warm. The Scout team was transparent about the process and what diagnostics they wanted to run and got my approval on an estimate before proceeding. The pricing also felt fair. I felt they were thorough and genuinely cared about my dog.  We were in and out in around an hour. I would definitely come back here for my dog's urgent care needs.
Great option for urgent care! Efficient and effective. Moo Moo left with a treat, toy and customized bag. Super cute! :)

I brought my dog Mabel in on a Friday afternoon, having booked an appointment earlier that day. She was in a ton of pain. By the time we left, the Scout staff had helped a ton. She felt miles better, and Mabel was like a totally new person.
Very knowledgeable and kind staff! Left with a lot of answers and medicine for my pup.

I write this message to sincerely thank Dr. Alicea Klemas for the superior care that she provided to my little Merrigold on 12 July. After two years of recurring ear infections and unsatisfactory results after many vet visits, I am happy to announce that the problem is finally solved. Dr. Klemas was the first vet in a long list to recommend the TrizUltra+Keto and an additional 7 days to the Mometamax on top of what other vets recommended. And she didn't do the sweet song and dance that most Chicago recently-out-of-veterinary-school vets offer. These young vets are the norm in Chicago. Dr. Klemas is clearly seasoned. She stormed into the room and grabbed Merrigold for the back room procedures. And when I objected to the pain medication, she set me straight. No other vet has done this before, rather letting me lead the conversation. She was in control and prescribed the solution that Merrigold (and I) needed. Her ears are so beautifully white and divine, and there's no more scratching or irritation. I am beyond grateful. Furthermore, Fran is GLORIOUS! The face, heart, and soul of Scout Lincoln Park. Thank you with all of my heart for superior service.

Hey Anna! 

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a five star review. We're so glad you had a great experience with our urgent care team, even though we know it's never fun to have to bring your pet in unexpectedly. Reviews like yours really do make a difference and help other pet parents feel confident choosing us for same-day and urgent care needs. We appreciate you taking the time to give us a shout-out.

Take Care,
The Scout team
I don’t normally post reviews but the team was so sweet and sent us home with a toy, treat, and even gave us this adorable drawing of Mewtwo and Bulbasaur (cats added for reference)

Hi Josh,

Thank you for the 5-star rating. We appreciate you taking a moment to support Scout.

Our team is grateful for the chance to care for pets and their people when the unexpected comes up. Thank you for trusting Scout Veterinary Urgent Care.

Take Care,
The Scout team

Outstanding urgent care. Very thorough and experienced care.  The doctor caught a symptom with our cat that our own vet missed which led them to find out what was wrong. Really amazing care here.  And we got in fast as well.
Brought my cat in and received great service from the vets, techs, and staff! They were very accommodating, provided great care, and allowed me to easily follow-up with any questions I had.

I had to take my cat in because she had jumped down and landed wrong. She was limping and wincing. I called Scout and there were able to get me an appointment immediately. The techs and doctor were very sweet and kind. I was a nervous wreck and they made me feel comfortable and eased my anxiety. They were able to get xrays to rule out a break. When I came back to pick up Sabina after her xrays the doctor went through all of their findings and sent me home with meds for her. If you need an urgent care for your pet Scout vet and urgent care is the place! Highly recommend.
Service was excellent they explained everything to me clearly within two days my cat was feeling so much better highly recommended there services

From the moment I stepped into Scout Veterinary, I knew my cat, Lamar, was in great hands. As a first time pet owner, I was terrified when he started acting differently. My vet referred me to Scout in Lincoln Park & Lamar's concerns were immediately addressed.  Dr. Pia was incredibly thorough with x-ray findings, walked me through various treatment plans for Lamar, & was honest about cost the whole way through. The front desk & vet technician were very patient with me as I determined what my next steps would be (wish I could remember their names!) & answered all my questions regarding the payment plan they offer.  I could not have asked for better care, I am still so grateful. My best friend, Lamar's made a full recovery & is acting just like his old self again after being treated for gastroenteritis. Thank you Scout Team!!!
the team was so helpful when I brought my kitty in last minute. kind, knowledgeable, and patient. thank you for taking care of my best friend <3

Hey Ryan 

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We’re glad to know your experience with Scout was a positive one, and we appreciate you trusting us with your pet’s care.

We’re always working to make each visit feel clear, supportive, and easier to navigate. If there’s anything we could have done to make your experience even better, we’d be grateful to hear it. Feel free to reach out to support@scoutcare.com 

Take Care,
The Scout team
Excellent attention, from the receptionist to the team that gave the attention to my pet! 🙏🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼🙌🏼

Scout in Lincoln Park is the best. I brought my cat, Sprite, in for an emergency visit for his leg upon recommendation from my primary vet. I couldn't have asked for a better experience with Dr. Pia Gomez Postigo and the vet tech/entire staff. They were extremely communicative, answered my questions, and reassured me throughout the whole process. They made sure Sprite was well taken care of and comfortable, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. They even sent me home with a treat and a toy for my other cat at home! I highly recommend Scout.

Our visit to Scout Veterinary was terrific. Luckily our cat Harry had resolved his constipation issue on his own. The staff and vet were kind and Harry’s exam was thorough. I would highly recommend Scout for veterinary emergencies.
My dog was in and out! They were very nice and helpful.

This was my first time going to this veterinarian. It was also a sad time. I had to have my dog put to sleep. They made everything very special that day. They lit candles in the room. They dim the lights, they made it very, very, very comfortable for the passing of my fur baby. I am so glad that I found this business. Thank you so much for checking on me and helping me heal. I greatly appreciate you all. B my dog appreciated your kindness also and the way that you treated me with such dignity and respect. Again, thank you tons.

The staff at Scout was incredible. I brought my dog in with HGE and they were able to see him immediately. Every step was fully communicated and they were extremely transparent with all costs and procedures.

Although, we ultimately determined that it was the best decision to humanely euthanize, Dr. Gomez and her staff were patient, supportive, and kind. I can't thank them enough for showing me the kindness they did during such a hard decision.
When our cat hurt her paw, Scout was great! They had fast, same-day availability and an empathetic and caring team.
Facility was great, staff even better. Was able to make an appointment without issue and received solid on the spot care. Scout to me is unmatched when it comes to veterinary urgent care.

LOVED this place - my puppy was having some symptoms so I decided to bring him in on a Saturday afternoon - team including the vet was so thorough and sweet and when I sent them a video later they responded with a voicemail explaining exactly what was happening and how to address. Truly couldn’t be happier with the experience!

Had to rush my dog in after he swallowed something he shouldn't have, and Scout was incredible. They moved fast but never made me feel rushed. The vet walked me through exactly what was going on and what they were doing at every step.

Everyone there was calm, kind, and clearly cared about him, not just getting us in and out. If your dog ever has an emergency, go to Scout in Lincoln Park. I wouldn't hesitate for a second.

Been to two Scout locations for emergencies and they NEVER disappoint. They are kind, thorough, caring, and thoughtful. The offices are comfortable and clean. Everyone there is calm and makes you feel heard! You know your pet is getting the best care. Highly recommend! Also so easy to make an appointment online!

My cat Toast had a leg injury that needed immediate care and I was fortunate enough to find Scout. They were able to see Toast and I same day and got his leg cleaned up and on the mend. The team was extremely helpful, kind and really helpful and I would highly recommend them to anyone who is needing urgent care for their animals.

Do not use this place for stray kittens! We found a very sickly 4-week-old kitten who we took to this urgent care to see if they could help improve her health. Their staff somehow managed to allow the 4-week-old kitten to bite someone as she was having a butt probe. Since the kitten had not yet been vaccinated for rabies, we then had to go through the rabies observational process. In order to get that possibility removed from her record, we had to bring her back in for a 10-day follow-up that scout intended to charge us $200 for. When I spoke with Dominique, the hospital director for all scout locations, she defended text who allowed this 4-week old cat to bite someone and insisted that we would have to pay the $200 charge. Her staff had previously said that we would have to come back to scout to get this removed from her record, but Dominique told me that that was not true. We have spoken with the paws Foster system and also with Fullerton Animal Clinic, both of whom have thought that this entire situation is ridiculous. Dominique apparently did not think it was ridiculous and insisted on charging the $200 fee for the follow-up visit. I do not recommend this place, this has been unacceptable.
All staff members are very happy with the job.

Five stars for Scout Veterinary Care! They were absolutely amazing when my dog, Cember, needed urgent help for an infected rat bite. Their response time was incredibly fast, and their communication is unmatched they always called me back promptly whenever I had questions. I was also so impressed by how well they cooperated and shared information with our primary vet and internist. They truly care about their patients and work as a team with your existing vets. Thank you, Scout team, for helping Cember heal!

Hey there Alec! 

Thank you so much for the 5-star review. We’re grateful you took the time to share your support and so glad to know you had a positive experience with Scout.

When the unexpected comes up with your pet, our goal is always to make care feel clear, compassionate, and easier to navigate. Thank you for trusting Scout Veterinary Urgent Care. We’re happy we could be here for you and your pet.

Take Care,
The Scout team

I had a great experience with Scout!! I made a same day appointment online for my dog and everything went so smooth. He is very shy and everyone was so patient, gentle, and caring with him. They matched his pace to make him comfortable rather than rushing the appointment. I really appreciated that!

The team explained everything to me and answered all my questions. Reasonably priced as well in my opinion! I would definitely take my dog back to Scout if he needs Urgent Care again. They validate parking in the nearby garage too!

Great experience at Scout. Was able to book a last minute appointment online. The doctor and technician were very patient and caring with my dog and we're able to help him out.

Cost was extremely reasonable and they didn't try to upsell on extra things (they noted what else they could do for extra measure and the cost, but we're clear it was optional and could be skipped). They also offered send certain meds to a local pharmacy so I could get them at a lower cost.

Overall great experience and would recommend.

This was the best overall experience for my dog and myself. The staff and the doctor we all calm and proffesional, which kept my dog calm and at ease. The doctor was thorough and showed me all of the results and explained everything. The billing amount was upfront and was even lower in the end. I can't say enough about Scout. I would give it a 10 star if I could.

From the minute we walked in there, I knew we were in great hands. The staff are lovely and took outstanding care of my dog. They were totally transparent and fair with their pricing. Should we ever need urgent care again, I know exactly where to go.

Thank you very much!!!

Scout in Lincoln Park is amazing! I brought my cat, Wesley, to see Dr. Pia Gomez Postigo, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. She was incredibly thorough and took the time to explain possible issues, while also working with me to find the most cost effective next steps. I never felt rushed or pressured, which I really appreciated. She also shared great recs and preventative tips to help manage my cat’s anxiety and stress.

The entire staff/vet techs were just as kind, attentive, and welcoming - they showed Wes so much care and love!! It’s hard to find a vet that truly has your pet’s best interest in mind, shows compassion, and doesn’t treat your pet like just another case. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for high quality, cost effective care, especially if you need a last min appointment.

BEWARE! they do a better job of billing than listening.

The vet saw our dog and recommended diagnostic tests that were going to cost more than a month’s rent. She suggested testing for two potential ailments, and yet did not have an opinion on which ailment it was more likely to be.

Scout does not believe in sequentially testing to avoid stressing the dog- they wanted to bill for everything at once (even though some tests they conduct offer results immediately). After begging for a perspective of which ailment was more likely, they knocked down the diagnostic tests to the price of a half month’s rent (still in the 4 figures btw). Also, when I asked the vet tech about what the $200 charge for “other meds” in the cost estimate would be, she didn’t have a single clue.

We took our dog elsewhere- and it turns out her ailment was not even related to the two the Scout vet suggested! The Scout vet discounted several of the symptoms we described our dog as having. We would’ve paid thousands of dollars to have received negative results on those tests!

The $135 exam fee felt less of getting an answer and more of opening our wallets. If you live in Lincoln Park, the $30 uberpet to VEG will be well worth your time. Prices here are 15% higher than VEG, and in our case, we were talking about a magnitude of $1,000s.

If this place could my dog’s primary vet, we would switch in a heart beat. Everyone cared about my dog and provided her individual attention, understanding how to handle her because she’s a nervous dog. Dr. Gomez provided an explanation that was easy to understand and helped me weigh my options on the path forward.

We are incredibly grateful to the team at Scout for the compassion and care they showed our family during one of the hardest moments we’ve faced. My son had to say goodbye to his 16-year-old dog, Mace, and I wasn’t able to be there in person because I live out of state. The staff at Scout went above and beyond to support us from two different places—they allowed me to complete all of the paperwork and payment online so my son didn’t have to carry that burden in such an emotional moment.
More importantly, they treated my son with such kindness, patience, and reassurance. They made sure he didn’t feel alone and helped guide him through the process with genuine compassion and respect. It meant the world to me knowing he was in such caring hands when I couldn’t be there myself.
Thank you, Scout, for your professionalism, empathy, and for honoring Mace with such dignity. We will never forget your kindness.

I truly can’t thank this team enough! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and cared for. The staff was incredibly kind and patient, and the doctor took the time to thoroughly explain everything about my dog. They made a stressful situation feel calm and reassuring. I’m so grateful I found this place and will absolutely recommend it to anyone with pet concerns!

My cat swallowed a small piece of yarn and the team here walked me through everything they were doing and how long it would take, as well as breaking down costs. They were able to help her and make sure it didn’t pass through her system! Reasonably priced, wonderful staff, would recommend!
Took my cat in immediately. Helped stabilize her with hydration and pain meds. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Answered all my questions patiently and I had a TON of questions for them
Great service. Compassionate.  No wait time.

Incredible care. We were able to make a same day appointment and left with a thorough work up and treatment plan. The front desk, techs, and vets are all so kind and explain everything. So glad our primary vet recommended them for urgent appointments.

Great Experience- Our pup Teddy went to Bowie Barker and they let us know they found a tumor on our dog and that it needed immediate attention. We called Old Town Animal Care they were closing and recommended the emergency vet or Scout. We called Scout and got in for an appointment. They were wonderful. It was a positive experience. We highly recommend them for your urgent care needs.

I cannot recommend Scout more highly! They are so compassionate, thorough, and knowledgeable. I appreciate that they walk you through treatment options and provide estimates. They even included the cutest drawing in the bag of treats that made a hard day so much brighter! I have told all my friends how much I love this practice and Dr. Pia Gomez Postigo is the best.

I was a few days ago old when I found out urgent care for pets exists. It was the purrfect option for me to get my cat seen immediately by a vet without breaking the bank the way the ER would. The facility is so cute and the team was the best. It’s clear how much they all love animals and talked me through my treatment options with what was necessary vs what next steps to take if it didn’t work with an itemized cost breakdown of everything. If I could make Scout my primary I would. Love this team (and my cat purred the entire time so she didn’t hate it either)!

Scout Urgent Care provided exceptional care for my new kitten Teddy when we couldn't get into our regular vet. We were able to get a same-day appointment, the clinic was quiet, modern and clean, and Dr. Hill and the staff showed great care and attention to detail (honestly, more than my regular vet). We had follow up visits to check in on his progress and the experience and service was consistent every time. Also, I have never seen such detailed follow up vet notes - pages and pages of detail outlining the visit and follow up instructions (which were extremely helpful because we had a detailed at-home regimen to follow)! If Scout wasn't an urgent care facility, I would love for them to be my regular vet. This review is long overdue but Teddy is now a healthy, fluffy teenager!

We had such an amazing experience here at Scout. Our cat unfortunately had a very sudden serious emergency and the vet team at Scout worked so fast and tried their very hardest to make sure she was okay and I’m so grateful to them. Dr.Hill and her care team walked my partner and I through every step and made sure we understood what was happening and what our options were. Unfortunately our cat passed away at the ER later that day but the Scout team followed up with me and sent me a handwritten letter and flowers with their condolences. I definitely recommend them and their care staff and I will definitely have them as my primary care for my furry family!

Hi Samantha! 

Thank you so much for the five stars. It truly means a lot to our team to know you had a positive experience with us.

At Scout, we’re here for those unexpected pet moments that can’t wait—and we’re grateful you trusted us to be part of your pet’s care. Providing clear communication, compassionate urgent care, and a supportive experience for both pets and their people is always our goal!

We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback and hope you know we’re here whenever you need us.

Take Care,
The Scout team

A remarkably clean facility. Everyone was welcoming and understood the stress involved in bringing a beloved pet for urgent care. We were attended to quickly and sent home with clear instructions on how to administer the meds. I was extremely satisfied and highly recommend this place.
Very caring, fair price

I called after noticing my cat was having irregular behavior with urinating. They were kind both over the phone & in person. They got my cat in right away and I was impressed with how clean the space was. The vet tech came into our room within a couple of minutes and was so kind & considerate. They communicated very well throughout the entire visit with tests they were doing, areas of concern, and cost. Both the doctor and tech clearly cared about the wellbeing of my animal over profit. I truly appreciated the time they took to explain everything & they sent my cat home with medication & treats + toys which was very sweet!  Would absolutely return for any urgent care needs.

First time bringing my fur baby to Scout Urgent Care and it was a wonderful experience. The space was very clean and organized, and the staff were beyond sweet.  It was truly evident how much they genuinely care about the pets that come through their doors. Highly recommend!

I took my cat , Daisy, there for a UTI and they fit us in quick, they listened to what was wrong and treated her with care. They didn’t force for any treatment, explained all the treatments options, and let me decide which would work for my situation. Highly recommend going to Scout. There team is fantastic!!

Our visit to Scout was efficient, thorough and fast. Our dog was not well but after being seen and cared for by the team at Scout Lincoln Park, she is back to feeling great and we will definitely be back to Scout for our pet care needs.
Wonderful team, thorough and prompt!

Went in over a holiday as our primary was closed.  In any situation where your pet is sick nerves are high.  From the front desk to the technician to the Dr this establishment goes above and beyond making sure all your concerns and your pets are addressed.  Everyone is warm and knowledgeable and the Dr was amazing I highly recommended this office.

Dr Hill, Shantelle, and front desk Jenny are great people.
Our cat passed a foreign object in her stool but wasnt healing as expected. Dr and staff were very helpful, gentle, and very accommodating
Everyone has amazing bed side manners and they exemplify what healthcare should look like. Thank you guys and happy holidays

My boy always got himself injured somehow. Scout is my go-to place when there is something happening to him. Staff there are nice and professional and always take good care of my sick boy, especially during weekends when our regular vet place is closed.
Very friendly and caring staff!

My cat receives thorough care here.  It's clean and the customer service is fantastic.  Great for pet caretakers who appreciate learning more about their pet's health.

Parking across the street is validated.  Go there.  For those who remember the old neighborhood, forget it.  It's VERY densely built up now and so easy to pass by if you're very easily distracted, oops!
Quick, thorough, competent, careful, and very helpful. Took good care of our pup.
Everyone was wonderful! They took the time to listen to everything that was going on. They not only made my dog feel safe and calm but also me as the owner.

Hi, the clinic aesthetic is welcoming, very clean and tidy. The staff were all friendly and very clearly knew what they were doing. Very organized and efficient. Prices were confirmed up front and are normal for an urgent care clinic. Urgent care will always be more expensive than your regular vet. My dog was well looked after and diagnosed well. I was given all the information I needed and was grateful that I had full control over deciding the next steps in his care based on the information I had received. I would definitely come back here if he got sick again.

After he started his medication, he immediately began to improve and I’m happy to report my buddy is on the mend and quickly!

Thanks to the team!
Scout is the emergency service linked to my vet. I made an appointment on a Sunday and my small dog was seen quickly. Staff was lovely.

I am so thankful for the Scout team! My 9 year old dog had a bad limp and his vet couldn’t get him in same day. Scout had SO many same day appointments! They explained everything in detail that was understandable, they made tucker feel so comfortable, and truly made sure he was taken care of. I am so grateful and would come back for any urgent need for my dog!!

Dr. Gomez was amazing - she was so thorough and explained everything to us when we brought our sick dog in. Amy was amazing too and made us feel comfortable in a normally uncomfortable situation! I highly recommend Scout and their team for anyone in the area who needs urgent care for their pet. I know I will be back if I ever need to!

I went in recently because my dog had ate some bones and was not acting well at all but I came here for him to get treated and all the staff was super friendly and welcoming , they gave me multiple options to my issue and explained everything really good and even sent emails explaining everything they told me , I would totally bring my dog back here if needed very appreciative for all the staff.

We brought our dog Crash into urgent care today, and the experience was exceptional. The staff (I believe Amy,in take tech) was so kind, patient, and compassionate. The clinic was clean and welcoming, and everyone went above and beyond to explain what was
happening. Dr. Aria Hill every question — even when I needed to ask twice — and never made me feel silly for it. Although Crash needed more care than they could provide, they made sure we were completely set up for success with the specialist at MedVet ER. Thanks to their knowledge and kindness, we were able to make the best decisions for our boy, even though they were hard ones. Truly grateful for their care and support. Highly recommend.

Hi Angela

We’re sorry to see that you had a less than stellar experience with us. That’s never the experience we want for our clients or their pets.

We’d really appreciate the chance to learn more about what happened so we can address it directly. If you’re open to it, please reach out to us at support@scoutcare.com so that we can gather more information.

Take Care,
The Scout team

I can’t say enough good things about Scout! I was able to make a same day appointment for 10:30 am. They were able to remove the thorn logged in my pup’s paw, drain the abscess (that was missed by our primary vet) and provide some relief, care, comfort and reassurance. I didn’t have to wait hours at an ER vet when our primary couldn’t see us, and we were so well taken care of. The staff was kind, compassionate and informative. Highly recommended Scout and would definitely return if another urgent issue arises in the future. THANK YOU- Eden 🐾

Hey Maya 

Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re so glad you chose Scout and appreciate your trust in our team. We’ll be here whenever the unexpected comes up again.

Take Care,
The Scout team

Everyone was so kind to me and my baby. I had a great experience with Scout Veterinary Urgent Care - Lincoln Park. Thank you for your guidance and taking such good care of my little Powder. I highly recommend.
Thank you Dr.Aria Hill and everyone.

Hi Thomas 

We’re sorry to hear your experience left you feeling this way. Our goal is to make urgent care for cats and dogs both accessible and transparent, especially in those stressful “can’t wait” moments.

Your feedback matters, and it helps us continue improving how we care for pets and their people.

Take Care, 
The Scout team.

Great experience all around, the staff are knowledgeable and kind. The doctor was helpful and patient, and answered all my questions without pushing me out the door. The only reason it’s not 5 stars is because of how expensive their prices are.

Had a phenomenal experience multiple times this week at Scout. It’s never fun when our pets are unwell. Dr. Simpson and the entire staff at the Lincoln Park location make your pet and you feel at ease and clearly explain everything.  Grateful to have this location close to us.

If I have a choice for urgent care I will always choose Scout. They are amazing. I brought an injured feral and they accommodated. They checked up on him later via text. Just overall an amazing clinic.
Staff and vet were very kind and helpful. They did great with our cat and explaining what they needed to do and why, as well as breaking down the expenses for us.

Hey Megan, 

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We’re grateful you chose Scout Veterinary Urgent Care in Lincoln Park. Our team is here to provide same-day urgent care for dogs and cats—whether it’s sudden limping, vomiting, skin issues, or anything else that just can’t wait for a regular vet appointment and not serious enough for the ER.

Your support to our team means a lot! If you ever need us again, we’re right here in Lincoln Park and always ready to help.

Take Care,
The Scout team

My beloved got into the garbage which involved some alarming symptoms. This was late afternoon on a Friday and our vet is closed on Saturdays. Booked online and Scout contacted my vets office for records!!!  Can you believe it?!  From start to finish an attentive, warm, compassionate emergency care facility.  Dr. Gomez was thorough and we received wonderful, spot-on care. Thank you everyone!!!!!   me + wonder

Compassion, competency and professionalism are combined perfectly by all the staff members of this 5 Star facility. They work beautifully as a team leaving both client and client-parent very satisfied with the outcome regardless of circumstances. Very grateful to have found this gem.🙏💜 …

I would highly recommend Scout to anyone having to bring their pet to this location! I brought my cat here at my vet’s recommendation because I had to get him seen urgently and the staff was super attentive and were able to get me in same day. The staff kept me up-to-date as they were checking out my cat and provided excellent and quick care. Super friendly and they also validate parking for the parking garage across the street so it’s convenient even if you have to make a trek to get to this location. My boy is doing so much better now!
Great service. Very caring. Helpful understanding options and costs.

Excellent veterinary care. Dr. Hill & Brianna took great care of Squirrel. After going there to get her first round of vaccination shots, she always sits in front of the store wanting to go in. I've never seen a dog who wants to go to the vet, but this picture is proof (taken days after we went on our walk).
Grateful to Dr. Gomez and the whole team at Scout who helped our dog. They were thorough, clear and instructive when helping us deal with a stressful issue. Would absolutely recommend.
They took amazing care of our pup on short notice, would highly recommend

Hi Kel! 

Thank you for the 5-star review. We’re so glad you chose Scout Veterinary Urgent Care for your pet’s needs. From minor injuries to more serious concerns, our team is here to provide trusted, same-day care for dogs and cats when the unexpected happens. We’re always just around the corner if you need us again! 

Take care, 
The Scout team

Hey there! 

Thank you for the 5-star rating. We’re so glad you had a positive experience with Scout Veterinary Urgent Care. Whether it’s a sudden limp, vomiting, a wound that won’t heal, or something that just doesn’t seem right, we’re here with same-day urgent care for dogs and cats when it matters most.
